author: (Potiez & Michaud, 1838)

note.en: A pheasant snail about 5 mm long with a tessellated pattern. Collected at Manzanillo, Punta Uva and the Puerto Viejo pier (1998 to 2000). Too small to notice.
note.es: Un caracol faisán de unos 5 mm con diseño de mosaico. Recolectado en Manzanillo, Punta Uva y el muelle de Puerto Viejo (1998 a 2000). Demasiado pequeño para notarlo.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Collected at Manzanillo, Punta Uva and Puerto Viejo pier.
